name: branding-black-house-leaf-logo-construction-grid
title: House and Leaf Logo Construction
whatItIs: A black page showing the house-and-leaf logo in dark grey with its construction geometry: circles, diagonals and vertical guides, framed by small labels for brand identity, logo draft and project.
whatItMeans: Revealing the geometry shows rigour and craft, and the near-invisible grey on black feels like a technical drawing.
techniques: Construction circles and diagonal guides drawn over the mark
Four corner labels framing the mark
Symmetry and tangent circles explaining curves

vocabulary.definition: Circles and lines that show how a logo was built.
Circles touching at a single point to define curves.
A presentation of a logo in its construction stage.
